title: Rural Drinking-Water Quality Monitoring: General Information
sourceName: Drinking Water Quality Monitoring & Surveillance Framework
publisher: National Jal Jeevan Mission, Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti
summary: The official Jal Jeevan Mission framework describes water-quality testing, monitoring, surveillance, and community awareness as parts of rural drinking-water quality management.

sections.heading: Monitoring and surveillance
sections.content: The framework describes water-quality monitoring and surveillance as activities supported by testing, laboratory systems, and ongoing review of water-quality information.

sections.heading: Community awareness
sections.content: The framework includes involving communities in water-quality monitoring and surveillance and building awareness about the importance of water-quality testing.

sections.heading: Information boundary
sections.content: General information about monitoring cannot determine the quality or safety of water at a particular home, source, or time. Local test results and responsible authorities are needed for such decisions.

scope: General information about rural drinking-water quality monitoring and awareness only; no diagnosis, interpretation of a specific result, treatment prescription, emergency advice, or local test result.
verificationNotes: Reviewed against the official Jal Jeevan Mission Water Quality Monitoring & Surveillance Framework on 2026-08-08. Historical statistics, funding, targets, and technical protocols were excluded.
